description: Streams and tasks through the SQL surface: SHOW STREAMS cells (table_name, source_type Table, mode DEFAULT / APPEND_ONLY), the delta a stream reports for inserts, updates (a DELETE+INSERT pair both flagged METADATA$ISUPDATE) and deletes, an APPEND_ONLY stream reporting only the insert, consumption by INSERT ... SELECT, and DROP STREAM. Tasks: CREATE with an interval or a cron schedule, the SHOW TASKS schedule and state cells, RESUME / SUSPEND moving the state, DROP TASK, and a stream left unconsumed by merely creating a task over its table. Converted from features/StreamsAndTasksTest; its task-execution test stays in the trimmed Java class (it drives engine.getTaskScheduler().executeTaskNow and reads the task's execution history, neither of which has a SQL surface).
